name_for_human: Shorted - Australian Market, Housing & Political Data
description_for_human: Track ASX short selling positions, Australian house prices and suburb metrics, ABS/RBA economic series, and the federal register of members' and senators' interests.
description_for_model: Shorted.com.au publishes four Australian datasets through one public API. (1) ASIC short positions for every ASX-listed security: current short interest percentages, full daily history since 2010, industry treemaps, screeners and weekly/monthly/yearly reports. ASIC data carries a T+4 trading day delay. (2) Australian housing: ABS/RBA house price indices, per-suburb median prices, sales volumes, Census demographics, electoral and crime overlays, and residential price-drop tracking. (3) Economic series by state: ABS and RBA indicators covering CPI, labour force, trade, state final demand, building approvals, retail turnover, government finance, petroleum and population. (4) The federal register of members' and senators' interests: what politicians have declared they hold (shareholdings, property, memberships, gifts) - what is held, never how much. Every endpoint is a Connect-RPC method: call it with an HTTP POST to https://api.shorted.com.au/<package>.<Service>/<Method>, a JSON request body, Content-Type: application/json, and the Connect-Protocol-Version: 1 header. The full machine-readable description of every endpoint is at https://shorted.com.au/openapi.json (YAML twin at https://shorted.com.au/openapi.yaml); a JavaScript-free markdown reference with worked examples is at https://shorted.com.au/docs/api.md. Public endpoints work without authentication at the anonymous tier; a bearer token raises the rate limits. Note that the edge rejects requests whose User-Agent starts with 'curl/' - send any other identifying User-Agent.
